title: FifthSense
summary: Real-time gesture recognition for deaf users. I designed the ML gesture-prediction pipeline, built an approach for continuous real-time prediction, and I'm architecting the platform backend.
source: LinkedIn experience (Glovatrix) and Adhish's LinkedIn post about the Royal Orchid pilot

title: UPI Replication System
summary: A payment system modelled on NPCI's UPI, built to reason about correctness. A payment saga with a state machine, a transactional outbox and idempotent ledger postings. A timed-out credit is resolved against the bank, never blindly retried.

title: Ride-hailing demand and supply platform
summary: An operational ride platform of nine FastAPI services, plus a separate multi-tenant ML service that forecasts ride demand per zone and time window.

title: FinSec Vault
summary: A Spring Boot 3 banking backend with OTP registration, JWT authentication and role-based approvals for customers, tellers and managers, with risk flagging and audit trails.
source: GitHub README: adhishpawar/FinSec-Vault and LinkedIn projects

title: FusionX
summary: A hybrid deep-learning model that detects deepfake images by combining CNNs for pixel-level features with Transformers for semantic context.
source: LinkedIn projects: FusionX, Deepfake Image Detection

title: TimesheetPA
summary: A Microsoft Teams chatbot that logs timesheet entries from plain-language messages, using GPT-4o-mini to extract the date, project, task and hours.
